identity.historic_use: Jenny Lake Museum and Visitor Center
excluded_lookalikes: Jenny Lake Visitor Center / Harrison Crandall Studio
J. Manges Cabin / James or Jimmy Manges Cabin near Cottonwood Creek

vertical.source_imperial: peak 18 feet 0 inches; ceiling line 7 feet 9 inches

roof.topology: single primary gable with ridge along the long building axis
roof.pitch_derivation: Half of the documented 20-foot-6-inch width equals the difference between the documented 18-foot peak and 7-foot-9-inch ceiling line. Confirm eave/ceiling registration during clay review.

porch.topology: supported shed canopy over a timber deck and central steps
porch.estimate_policy: Provisional values traced from the scaled sheet-2 plan; retain explicit estimate status until full-resolution vector measurement.

addition.description: Room added at the east end, probably by Civilian Conservation Corps labor.
addition.geometry_policy: Preserve the documented internal wall/joint and exterior opening arrangement without inventing a separate roof mass.

west.position: right of window beneath supported porch

openings.registration_policy: The deterministic draft uses visually traced centers. Final production geometry must replace them with full-resolution sheet measurements.

west_gable.feature: diagonal-log king-post treatment above the porch
west_gable.signage_policy: Omit lettering and sign surface until a target-period, rights-cleared same-building reference establishes it.

runtime_placement.height_policy: Use the HABS 5.4864-metre ridge above floor for geometry; retain the 6.9-metre field only as source-dataset provenance.
